text:
Asha (People Ops): Quick ping  last call for the annual attestations + SOC2 evidence intake. Hard deadline is Wed 05/18 17:00 PT. Short checklist and upload rules below.

Ben (Security): Please surface Access Reviews, Vendor packets for any vendor touching customer data, KMS rotation logs, and a single incident tabletop note if applicable. Those four are audit priorities.

Clara (Eng): For access reviews: will CSV exports with query + export timestamp work or do auditors want UI screenshots too?

Ben (Security): CSV + one-line query + timestamp preferred. Screenshot only if CSV not available. Include README with the exact query.

Diego (Data): File naming pattern? Our scripts will fail if not exact.

Asha (People Ops): Naming (automation validates):
<YYYYMMDD>_<team>_<control>.<ext>
examples:
20260518_eng_access_review.csv
20260518_legal_vendor_packet.pdf
20260518_infra_kms.csv
Make sure the date is the upload date. Uploader: https://go.redwood.company/attestation-upload

Elena (Legal): Procurement backlog question: if vendor questionnaire is pending, is a signed SOW + procurement status email acceptable as provisional evidence?

Ben (Security): Yes  PO/SOW + procurement email with expected delivery works as provisional. Mark "provisional" in the form and follow up within 7 business days.

attest_bot: Reminder scheduled  "Attestation + SOC2 evidence due Wed 05/18 17:00 PT". Will post in #people-ops and DM owners at 09:00 on due day.

Clara (Eng): Dashboards show relative timestamps (1 hour ago). Need absolute times?

Ben (Security): Absolute timestamps required. If UI lacks them, include the query/export file and run timestamp in README. Screenshots alone may be rejected.

Diego (Data): We're bundling a single zip per team. Should README be a plain text file or Markdown?

Asha (People Ops): README.txt is preferred (one-line descriptions per file). Zip must be flat and README at root. Nested folders cause auto-reject.

Elena (Legal): Contractor/vendor portal logs  sponsor attestation required?

Asha (People Ops): Yes, sponsor must be a full-time Redwood employee. Upload sponsor email + brief note in the upload form. No anonymous exceptions.

Clara (Eng): Office hours for final triage?

Asha (People Ops): Two sessions: Tue 10:00-11:30 PT and Wed 13:00-15:00 PT. Link in the compliance page. Drop in or book a 15-min slot if you need 1:1 help.

Ben (Security): Reminder: redact PII before upload. If redacting, add a one-line note describing what was redacted.

Asha (People Ops): One last item: mismatched filenames or nested zips will be auto-rejected and delay attestation. Please triple-check. Thanks everyone  appreciate the quick turns on this. :heart:
